title: The bottleneck map: what each surviving explanation can claim
nature: a reading of the record, not new evidence

vocabulary.rule: the scope is part of the status; where the evidence splits, a compound status is required

rows.label: weakened
rows.check: presence was ruled out in the tested worlds: all 112 true world edges were in memory, so a shortage of candidates is not the constraint there, while the candidate space's ordering is the measured defect
rows.does_not_say: that a different generation strategy cannot help. Presence of the true edges was measured; which pairs a generator proposes was not
rows.would_change: a generation rule that changes which pairs enter at all, shown to move precision at a fixed budget

rows.label: demonstrated constraint on coverage; effect on behavior untested
rows.check: under the engine's own global count-ranked selection the 112 world edges are spread, not clustered: the top 20 recovers 0-1, the top 40 0-2, the top 80 8-16, the top 160 36-55 and the top 320 (about 16x the budget) 106-109; precision never exceeds 0.3438 across 36 measurements under two allocation rules
rows.does_not_say: that fixing selection fixes behavior. No cell has shown a downstream gain from a better-ranked selection, which is why the first status is scoped to coverage and the second is not established
rows.would_change: the density study's treatment arm, if the treated ranking moves a behavioral endpoint

rows.label: unresolved
rows.check: Phase L measured structural displacement, and DI/PI are retention indices; its verdict stands at H3-L - INCONCLUSIVE. The capacity-1,000 confirmatory test found no improvement on held-out prediction, with its interval crossing zero
rows.does_not_say: that structure fails to transfer. Retention was measured; usability of what is retained was not
rows.would_change: a study that scores behavior from carried structure instead of retention of that structure

rows.label: supported concern
rows.check: the architecture's own motivational mechanisms were disabled one at a time and scored on the predicted direction: three of five predictions reversed, including contradiction's weight and question generation
rows.does_not_say: that the theory is refuted, or that these reversals cause any downstream failure. The concern is supported; the causal link is not
rows.would_change: a mechanism whose predicted direction holds under a matched ablation

rows.label: preregistered, untested
rows.check: none has run: a design record names the manipulated ratio, the treatment, the estimand and the falsifiers, and allocates nothing
rows.does_not_say: that density matters. No cell has run, and the 448-cell decay null held world geometry fixed and never varied density
rows.would_change: the study itself; its predicted direction and falsifiers are fixed before any cell

rows.label: not supported
rows.check: the paired-capacity records found no pool-structure moderation; this artifact does not restate their numbers, and the status is the owner's reading of them
rows.does_not_say: that pool structure is refuted. No support in the conditions tested is not evidence of absence
rows.would_change: a test that manipulates pool structure independently of size and scale

rows.label: not supported
rows.check: the ratio- and temporal-redundancy preregistrations and their block records tested redundancy as a moderator; this artifact does not restate their numbers, and the status is the owner's reading of them
rows.would_change: a world where redundancy varies while pool and scale are held fixed

rows.label: unresolved
rows.check: two points of the parameter range: 0.95 fails the harness liveness criterion on the matrix stream and horizon, while 1.0 passes it through cycle 2,999 (owner-reported)
rows.does_not_say: that decay is unnecessary, or that decay is necessary. Neither direction was tested
rows.would_change: the matched decay-on/off comparison that estimates the parameter's effect with everything else held fixed

corrections.why: 'not supported' reads as a tested hypothesis found against. What ran was two points of the parameter range on one stream and horizon; necessity was never tested

corrections.now: demonstrated constraint on coverage; effect on behavior untested
corrections.why: the demonstrated result is that frequency ranking cannot surface the world's edges at the engine's budget. No cell shows that a better-ranked selection improves a behavioral endpoint, so the second half stays unestablished

specified_experiment.note: the only row with a defined manipulation, an explicit estimand, a registered direction, falsifiers and zero allocated seeds

provenance.source: the owner's map, 2026-11-07, with two rows corrected in the same exchange
provenance.checked_note: statuses and figures for these rows were checked against the records named in evidence
provenance.owner_reading_note: these statuses are the owner's reading; the named records are where a reader checks them, and this artifact restates none of their numbers
provenance.rule: a status added here needs a check behind it, not a story

not: a likelihood ranking: statuses are not probabilities and the rows are not ordered by promise
a re-scoring of H3-L, of the 448-cell calibration null, or of any Phase K result
an allocation: no seed, cell, threshold or bar is spent here
a replacement for the records it points at; when they change, this map is re-read against them

weakened.means: evidence bears against the explanation as the dominant one, within the tested scope
weakened.status: Supported within the tested scope + Not established / not measured

demonstrated constraint on coverage; eff.means: evidence supports a limit within the tested scope, and the wider effect was not measured
demonstrated constraint on coverage; eff.status: Supported within the tested scope + Not established / not measured

supported concern.means: a prediction the explanation makes failed, so the concern is real

not supported.means: a tested prediction did not materialize, or the evidence did not appear where it would have
not supported.gap: the four-status vocabulary has no separate 'tested and not supported' category. The closest, 'not established / not measured', means the record cannot decide, which is wrong for a test that ran and returned nothing. This label is the map's, and the gap is recorded here rather than absorbed

unresolved.means: the record cannot decide the question

preregistered, untested.means: a design is frozen and no runtime evidence exists
